combo_box.name: aa_method_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Anti-aliasing method. Changing causes a brief hitch.

combo_box.name: aa_quality_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Quality preset for the selected anti-aliasing method

check_box.label: Screen space reflections
check_box.tool_tip: Ray-marched reflections of on-screen geometry. Toggling rebuilds shaders (brief hitch).
check_box.name: reflect_ssr

combo_box.name: reflect_detail_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How reflection probes update. Raytraced: as Realtime, but the probe faces are ray traced (Vulkan, ray-tracing GPUs; otherwise Realtime). Changing causes a brief hitch.

combo_box.name: reflect_level_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How much of the scene gets probe coverage

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_reflect_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Iterations
slider.name: ssr_iterations
slider.tool_tip: Ray-march steps to find a hit; more is more accurate but slower

slider.label: Ray step
slider.name: ssr_raystep
slider.tool_tip: Distance covered by each ray-march step

slider.label: Distance bias
slider.name: ssr_distance_bias
slider.tool_tip: Bias used when rejecting a potential reflection sample

slider.label: Depth reject bias
slider.name: ssr_depth_bias
slider.tool_tip: Bias against the depth buffer before rejecting a sample

slider.label: Adaptive step
slider.name: ssr_adaptive_step
slider.tool_tip: Multiplier for adaptive ray-march stepping

combo_box.name: reflect_count_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Maximum number of reflection probes

slider.label: Probe distance
slider.name: reflect_distance
slider.tool_tip: How far away probes are drawn and updated (meters)

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_reflect_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced reflection settings to defaults

check_box.label: Mirrors
check_box.tool_tip: High-quality planar mirror surfaces. Toggling causes a brief hitch.
check_box.name: reflect_mirrors

combo_box.name: mirrors_res_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Resolution of mirror (hero probe) surfaces

combo_box.name: mirrors_rate_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How often mirror surfaces refresh

combo_box.name: shadow_detail_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which lights cast shadows. Changing rebuilds shaders (brief hitch).

combo_box.name: shadow_filter_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How wide a kernel softens the shadow edge. Ultra switches to contact hardening: the shadow is sharp where the caster meets the ground and softens with distance from it. Higher tiers cost more texture fetches. Applies to shadow maps; ray-traced shadows use Shadow softness.

combo_box.name: shadow_res_scale_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Sun/moon shadow map resolution per cascade (same as Preferences > Graphics > Lighting > Shadow quality). With ray-traced shadows it sets the rays per pixel instead (Low 1 ... Ultra 4).

combo_box.name: shadow_avatar_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How much avatar geometry casts shadows

check_box.label: Translucent shadows (tinted by glass)
check_box.tool_tip: Translucent objects cast partial shadows tinted by their colour, so stained glass throws coloured light. Off: they cast hard, alpha-tested shadows.
check_box.name: shadow_translucent

combo_box.name: shadow_sun_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How the sun and moon cast shadows (needs Shadows: Sun/Moon or higher). Shadow maps are the classic cascades. Ray traced traces a ray toward the sun per pixel: pixel-exact contact shadows with soft edges and no cascade seams or shimmer, at a higher GPU cost. Needs a GPU with hardware ray queries.

combo_box.name: shadow_proj_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How projector lights stop at the first surface they hit (needs Shadows: Sun/Moon + Projectors). Ray traced needs a GPU with hardware ray queries.

combo_box.name: shadow_rt_res_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Resolution ray-traced shadows (sun, moon, projectors) are traced at, relative to the screen. Lower is faster; the shadow edges are upscaled following the scene depth so they don't bleed across objects. Only used with ray-traced shadows.

combo_box.name: shadow_update_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How often distant sun/moon shadows are redrawn. Nearby shadows (you, nearby avatars, your vehicle) always update every frame. Balanced and Performance reuse distant shadow maps for a few frames; far-away moving objects' shadows may lag slightly.

slider.label: RT shadow softness
slider.name: shadow_rt_softness
slider.tool_tip: How soft the edges of ray-traced shadows are (sun, moon and projectors). 0 = razor sharp. Higher values widen the penumbra, more so the further a shadow falls from its caster.

slider.label: Projector shadow budget
slider.name: shadow_proj_budget
slider.tool_tip: Shadow maps: how many projector lights cast shadows at once (brightest and closest first). 0 = no projector shadows. Values above 16 need a restart.

check_box.label: Ambient occlusion (SSAO)
check_box.tool_tip: Screen-space ambient occlusion. Toggling rebuilds shaders (brief hitch).
check_box.name: shadow_ssao

combo_box.name: godrays_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Volumetric light shafts from the sun and moon through gaps in trees, windows and other geometry. Marched through the sun/moon shadow maps, or traced against the scene with ray-traced sun shadows, so they need shadows on (not shown under water). Higher tiers cost more GPU time and look smoother.

slider.label: God ray intensity
slider.name: godrays_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the light shafts. Scales the scattering of the sky's haze, so hazier skies give stronger shafts.

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_shadow_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Bias
slider.name: shadow_bias
slider.tool_tip: Sun/moon shadow-map compare bias (normalized light depth), subtracted when sampling. Raise to remove shadow acne; too high detaches shadows from their casters (peter-panning). 0 = rely on the raster and normal-offset bias.

slider.label: Offset
slider.name: shadow_offset
slider.tool_tip: Sun/moon shadow sample offset

slider.label: Projector normal offset
slider.name: shadow_spot_bias
slider.tool_tip: Shadow-mapped projectors: receiver offset along the surface normal, in shadow texels. Raise if lit faces show acne; lower if light leaks right behind thin casters.

slider.label: Projector light offset
slider.name: shadow_spot_offset
slider.tool_tip: Shadow-mapped projectors: receiver offset toward the light, in shadow texels. Large values let light leak through thin walls right in front of the receiver.

slider.label: RT shadow bias
slider.name: shadow_rt_bias
slider.tool_tip: Ray-traced shadows (sun, moon, projectors): EXTRA shadow-ray origin offset in metres along the surface's geometric normal. Origins are already moved off the surface by its float precision (a fraction of a millimetre), so 0 is right for matching geometry. Raise only if lit surfaces show self-shadowing speckle; a few millimetres skip layered avatar skins and detach thin contact shadows.

slider.label: Blur size
slider.name: ssao_blur_size
slider.tool_tip: Width of the blur that softens the occlusion buffer. Despite the setting's name this no longer affects shadow edges: shadow filtering is weighted at the source, so this pass blurs ambient occlusion only.

slider.label: Scale
slider.name: ssao_scale
slider.tool_tip: Sampling radius scale for ambient occlusion

slider.label: Max scale
slider.name: ssao_max_scale
slider.tool_tip: Cap on the screen-space sampling radius (pixels). Vulkan: legacy capped AO path only (RenderVKAODepthMips off)

slider.label: Factor
slider.name: ssao_factor
slider.tool_tip: Strength falloff factor for occlusion

spinner.name: vec3_RenderSSAOEffect_0
spinner.tool_tip: Brightness (HSV value) multiplier for fully occluded areas; partial occlusion blends toward the original color

button.name: ssao_effect_rst
button.tool_tip: Reset the occlusion effect (both components) to default

spinner.name: vec3_RenderSSAOEffect_1
spinner.tool_tip: Saturation multiplier for fully occluded areas; partial occlusion blends toward the original color

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_shadow_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced shadow and AO settings to defaults

slider.label: Draw distance (m)
slider.name: perf_farclip
slider.tool_tip: How far the world is drawn, in meters (up to 4096). Loaded regions are capped at a 5x5 square around yours (SlipstreamMaxRegionRing).

slider.label: Object detail
slider.name: perf_volume_lod
slider.tool_tip: Level-of-detail factor for objects; higher keeps detail visible farther away

slider.label: Max avatar complexity
slider.name: perf_max_complexity
slider.tool_tip: Avatars above this rendering cost draw as solid-color JellyDolls. 0 = no limit.

slider.label: Max animated avatars
slider.name: perf_max_nonimpostors
slider.tool_tip: Avatars beyond this count render as cheap impostors. 0 = animate everyone.

combo_box.name: perf_texcomp_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Stores textures block-compressed in video memory, encoded on the GPU as they load: 4-8x less texture memory. High quality: BC7, best encoder (1 byte per texel), no visible loss. Balanced: BC7, faster encoder. Max savings: BC1 for opaque textures (half a byte), BC3 with alpha; slight gradient banding. Adaptive: per texture -- BC1 / BC3 where it measured as good as BC7, else BC7; far-away textures use the smaller formats. Applies live -- loaded textures re-encode over a few seconds, so you can flip it and compare the same spot.

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_perf_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

combo_box.name: perf_complexity_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How the avatar complexity limit is applied

slider.label: Avatar detail
slider.name: perf_avatar_lod
slider.tool_tip: Level-of-detail factor for avatar meshes

slider.label: Avatar physics
slider.name: perf_physics_lod
slider.tool_tip: Level-of-detail factor for avatar physics (jiggle)

slider.label: Terrain detail
slider.name: perf_terrain_lod
slider.tool_tip: Level-of-detail factor for terrain

check_box.label: Smooth terrain
check_box.tool_tip: Draw the terrain as a smooth surface through its height samples. The simulator still collides with the flat one, so feet and objects can sit a few centimetres off on rough ground.
check_box.name: perf_terrain_smoothing

check_box.label: Hex-tile terrain textures
check_box.tool_tip: Show each terrain texture at a different offset and rotation in every cell of a hexagonal lattice, so its repeat does not show. Up to three fetches per texture instead of one. Rebuilds the terrain shaders.
check_box.name: perf_terrain_hex_tiling

slider.label: Tree detail
slider.name: perf_tree_lod
slider.tool_tip: Level-of-detail factor for Linden trees

slider.label: Flexiprim time
slider.name: perf_flex_time
slider.tool_tip: Update-time budget factor for flexible prims

slider.label: Max particles
slider.name: perf_max_particles
slider.tool_tip: Maximum particle count on screen

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_perf_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced performance settings to defaults

check_box.label: Fog from particles
check_box.name: pfog_on
check_box.tool_tip: Fog machines, smoke, steam and mist made of particles become lit volumetric fog. Needs volumetric fog (Preferences > Graphics).

combo_box.name: pfog_quality_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Low halves the march steps and resolution cost; High doubles the steps and raises the resolution

combo_box.name: pfog_debug_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Off; Conversion: tints each system red (partly) to green (fully converted) and draws its boxes; Erosion, Ambient occlusion and Local light show one lighting/shape term alone

slider.label: Density
slider.name: pfog_density
slider.tool_tip: How thick the fog is: higher makes solid, opaque clouds; low is a thin mist

slider.label: Billow
slider.name: pfog_billow
slider.tool_tip: How much of the fog is carved into separate lumps: low is one solid mass, high is lumps with gaps

slider.label: Billow size
slider.name: pfog_bscale
slider.tool_tip: Size of the lumps

slider.label: Edge erosion
slider.name: pfog_erosion
slider.tool_tip: How ragged and wispy the edges are

slider.label: Heaviness
slider.name: pfog_heavy
slider.tool_tip: How fast the fog sinks and pools along the floor (rising smoke and steam are not pulled down)

slider.label: Distance
slider.name: pfog_distance
slider.tool_tip: Beyond this many metres particle systems stay as ordinary particles

slider.label: March steps
slider.name: pfog_steps
slider.tool_tip: Medium-quality ray-march steps per pixel (the quality setting halves or doubles it)

slider.label: Resolution
slider.name: pfog_res
slider.tool_tip: Medium-quality render resolution of the fog, as a fraction of the screen

slider.label: Near resolution
slider.name: pfog_nearres
slider.tool_tip: Render resolution while fog is within about 4 m of the camera

slider.label: Smoothing frames
slider.name: pfog_history
slider.tool_tip: Frames blended together: more is steadier but trails when the fog moves

slider.label: Shadowed lights
slider.name: pfog_shadowl
slider.tool_tip: How many of the strongest local lights the fog shadows itself from

combo_box.name: preview_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Simulate color-vision deficiencies or show a false-color exposure map for checking your scene

combo_box.name: preview_cvd_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Daltonize the image to compensate for a color-vision deficiency

slider.label: Compensation amount
slider.name: preview_cvd_amount
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the CVD compensation
